breakpoints.note: The inline-link parser consumes attacker-controlled destination bytes and updates `off` to the byte immediately after the destination. This is the vulnerability-relevant source state that is later passed to the optional-title probe.

Root cause. After the optional whitespace pre-scan, the function assumes a title opener is present and dereferences `CH(off)` without first checking that `off` is still strictly inside the input buffer. When the caller passes an exhausted offset at line end, this missing bound check creates the overread condition consumed at the same statement.

Sink. `md_is_link_title()` dereferences the attacker-derived offset with `CH(off)` even when `off` already equals the end of the remaining markdown line, producing the saved one-byte heap-buffer-overflow read at the AddressSanitizer crash location.
